title: subject
description: One product or project and its exact identifiers across sources. See contracts/subject.md.

id.description: lowercase hex sha256 of the word subject, a newline, and the first identifier as scheme, a colon and value

name.description: the name the source gives it

identifiers.description: exact identifiers, the first being the one the source knows it by; two subjects sharing any identifier are the same subject

scheme.description: the identifier's kind; contracts/subject.md lists each scheme's grammar

fetched_at.description: when the response it came from was received, read from the kept response

private.description: true when it came from a private stream the owner consented to

raw_ref.description: where the raw response it came from is kept, relative to the store
